info.name: Mesh Gateway
info.description: Constitutional Mesh Gateway – proxy, hypermedia filtering, action execution, and approval workflow

item.name: 00 – P2P Setup (Foundation ERP fixture)
item.description: Creates a Supplier → Requisition (submit → approve → convert to PO) directly against Foundation ERP. Captures supplierId, requisitionId, and poId as environment variables for use in the mesh tests below.

item.name: 01 – O2C Setup (Foundation ERP fixture)
item.description: Creates Customer -> Quote -> Order -> Invoice -> Payment directly in Foundation ERP so O2C mesh GET/POST requests can run against real IDs.

exec: pm.test("Invoice generated or already exists", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 409]).to.include(code); });

request.description: Readiness probe – returns 200 when Authority Engine and Governance Engine are healthy and at least one registered backend adapter is healthy; 503 otherwise.

Fetches a canonical resource through the selected backend adapter and returns it with `links` filtered to only transitions the actor is constitutionally permitted to invoke. Denied transitions are removed; approval-required transitions are annotated.

exec: pm.test("Canonical resource contains id", function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Canonical resource includes links object", function () { pm.expect(body.links).to.be.an("object"); });

request.description: Issues a purchase order (Draft → Issued). If authority and governance allow it directly, Mesh forwards execution through the selected backend adapter and returns the adapter response (200/201).

exec: pm.test("Issue returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403]).to.include(code); });
pm.test("Approval payload has pending status", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("PENDING"); });

request.description: Acknowledges a purchase order (Issued → Acknowledged). Run after the issue step.

exec: pm.test("Acknowledge returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });

request.description: Illustrative only – when governance determines the action requires approval, the gateway returns HTTP 202 with a task ID. The response body contains `{ taskId, status: 'PENDING', requiredTier }`. Actual outcome (allow vs 202) depends on governance engine configuration for the actor/resource combination.

exec: pm.test("Issue replay check returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });

request.description: Posts a journal entry in the Record-to-Report domain.
Confirms a sales order in the Order-to-Cash domain.

exec: pm.test("Confirm returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }
pm.test("Allocate returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }
pm.test("Ship returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }
pm.test("Generate invoice returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }
if (code === 200 || code === 201) { var body = pm.response.json(); if (body.invoice_id) { pm.environment.set("invoiceId", body.invoice_id); } }
pm.test("Post invoice returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }
pm.test("Apply payment returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });

pm.test("Reconcile payment returns supported outcome", function () { pm.expect([200, 201, 202, 403, 409]).to.include(code); });
if (code === 202) { var body = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set("approvalExpected", "true"); pm.environment.set("approvalTaskId", body.taskId); }

request.description: Lists all PENDING approval tasks assigned to the given actor.

exec: pm.test("Approvals payload includes data array", function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Approval execution returns valid status", function () { pm.expect([200, 403, 409, 502]).to.include(code); });
pm.test("Approval result has EXECUTED status", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("EXECUTED"); });
pm.test("No pending approval task for this run", function () { pm.expect([404]).to.include(code); });

request.description: Approves a pending task. Mesh re-evaluates authority and governance before forwarding the original action through the stored backend adapter reference. On success the task transitions to EXECUTED. Returns 409 if the task is no longer PENDING, 403 if the actor is not assigned.
Rejects a pending approval task. The task transitions to REJECTED and is logged. Returns 409 if already decided, 403 if actor not assigned.
